description: This source file defines and exports an Express router for managing 'technicians'. It includes endpoints for retrieving a list of technicians and creating new technician records, with appropriate authentication and role-based access control.

methods.name: GET /api/technicians
methods.description: Retrieves a list of technicians, accessible by users with SuperAdmin or ServiceCenterAdmin roles.

methods.name: POST /api/technicians
methods.description: Creates a new technician record with provided details, accessible by users with SuperAdmin or ServiceCenterAdmin roles.
